01 · The list

Numbers,
level by level

The number words of Japanese from the JLPT lists: the digits, the tens, hundred, thousand and ten thousand, with the reading and meaning of each. Numbers are the first words that pay for themselves, since prices, dates, times and phone numbers all run on them.

In Lock&Learn Japanese these words sit in their level packs (JLPT N5, JLPT N4, JLPT N3, JLPT N2), one per glance on the widget: a word waits in kanji, the way the test shows it; one tap reveals the reading, the meaning and a real sentence. JLPT N5 is free; every other pack opens with a free preview and another word unlocks daily.

Type to filter by word, reading or meaning. Flashcards hides the reading and the meaning until you tap a row; Shuffle deals the list in a new order.

Japanese counts with two sets of numbers. The Sino-Japanese set (いち, に, さん …) is the everyday one: prices, dates, times, phone numbers and anything above ten. The native set (ひとつ, ふたつ, みっつ …) counts things up to ten when no counter word is used: "three apples" is りんごをみっつ.

NumberKanjiSino-JapaneseNative (counting things)
1一いち ichiひとつ hitotsu
2二に niふたつ futatsu
3三さん sanみっつ mittsu
4四よん yon / し shiよっつ yottsu
5五ご goいつつ itsutsu
6六ろく rokuむっつ muttsu
7七なな nana / しち shichiななつ nanatsu
8八はち hachiやっつ yattsu
9九きゅう kyuu / く kuここのつ kokonotsu
10十じゅう juuとお too
100百ひゃく hyaku
1,000千せん sen
10,000万まん man

Larger numbers stack from the top down: 二十三 is にじゅうさん (two-ten-three, 23), 三百 is さんびゃく (300, with a sound change), and Japanese groups by ten thousand rather than by thousand, so 100,000 is 十万 (ten ten-thousands). Four and seven use よん and なな in most everyday counting; し and しち survive in fixed contexts such as the months (四月 しがつ, 七月 しちがつ).

03 · Questions

Asked and
answered

How do I count in Japanese?

Start with one to ten from the table, then the tens, hundred and thousand; larger numbers are built by combining them, and the note above the list explains the system. The 36 words here are the number words on the JLPT vocabulary lists, each with its reading.

Which JLPT levels are these words from?

27 from JLPT N5, 1 from JLPT N4, 3 from JLPT N3, 5 from JLPT N2. The level chip on each row says where the word sits, so you can stop at your level or read ahead. Beginner-level words carry a real example sentence; the rest show word, reading and meaning, with their sentences in the app.

How do I learn numbers words on my iPhone Lock Screen?

Install Lock&Learn Japanese, then touch and hold your Lock Screen, tap Customize, tap the widget area and choose Lock&Learn Japanese. Enable the level packs these words come from (JLPT N5, JLPT N4, JLPT N3 and more). A word waits in kanji, the way the test shows it; one tap reveals the reading, the meaning and a real sentence.

Is Lock&Learn Japanese free?

Yes. The app is free on iOS: JLPT N5 is free, every other pack opens with a free preview, and another word unlocks daily. Lock&Learn+ is an optional upgrade that opens every pack at once, offered as a yearly plan or a one-time lifetime purchase.
